title: Laplacian and average coordinate flips
statement: For every function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and every point $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, the Laplacian satisfies $\Delta f(x)=\frac n2\left(f(x)-\mathbb E_i f(x^{(i)})\right)$, where $x^{(i)}$ is obtained by flipping coordinate $i$ and the expectation is the uniform average over coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\mathbb R$
